terms.boundary: Two fixed E8 RGBNT201 seed42 arms. Exact additive cosine accounting, not causal intervention. Test means only label terms, never calibrate embeddings or rank. All negatives retained when selecting the fixed G-hardest negative; all legal cross-camera positives retained. Probe margins are not AP and omit other negatives. Query/gallery overlap. Components share the observed denominator, so contributions are convention-dependent; large term magnitudes can cancel. Existing rank1 groups and metrics are copied, not recomputed. No new model, teacher, weight, hyperparameter selection, evaluation promotion or training.
